- Coroutines/Flow: `coroutineScope` + `async`/`await` for parallel work; combine results in data classes. Use `flow`/`emit`, `delay`, `flowOn`.
- Sealed interfaces: generic type parameter; data class success, `data object` stateless states. Use <REDACTED_USER> annotation with primitive-backed value class; validate with `init`/`require`.
- Ktor: `embeddedServer` with Netty, port, host; configure Koin, security, routing, content negotiation; `start(wait = true)`. Koin plugin/modules with `single`; JWT Authentication with realm, verifier, validate callback; ContentNegotiation with JSON. Define Application routing, `route`, `post`/`call.receive`, authenticated routes, `get`/`call.parameters`, `call.respond`.
- Exposed: `LongIdTable`, `varchar`, `enumerationByName`, `timestamp`, `uniqueIndex()`, `defaultExpression`; `LongEntity`/`LongEntityClass`, delegated properties, `toModel`. Repository suspend methods use `dbQuery`/`newSuspendedTransaction` with IO dispatcher; `findById`, `Entity.new`.

- Compose: <REDACTED_USER> function takes ViewModel/callbacks; collect state with `collectAsState`; handle Loading/Success/Error. List items use `Card`, `Modifier.fillMaxWidth`, clickable, `Row`, padded `AsyncImage`/`CircleShape`, `Column`, MaterialTheme typography.
- Tests: mockk dependencies; service initialized with mock; <REDACTED_USER> with `runTest`; `coEvery`/`coAnswers` with delay; `assertThat`. Flow: `toList`, assert size/content.
